# Kilometer 0 Digital

> EU-hosted private cloud and email from AMVARA CONSULTING S.L. Public pricing, human support. We do not sell your profile. Marketing site in Spanish (default), Catalan, English, and German.

KM0 Cloud is OpenCloud at cloud.km0digital.com. KM0 Email provides @km0digital.com mailboxes and Roundcube at mail.km0digital.com. Infrastructure runs in Germany (Hetzner). This file is a curated map for AI agents; prefer these URLs over crawling the full site.

- [Home (DE)](https://km0digital.com/de/): German landing
